<function name="ClearLuaErrorGroup" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Clears all Lua Errors with the given group id.</description>
	<realm>Menu</realm>
	<file line="73-L86">lua/menu/problems/problems.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="group_id" type="string">group_id to remove. Will be "[addon-name]-0" or "Other-"</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Creating an Error and Removing it from the Problems menu.</description>
	<code>
RunString("Error") -- Errors not created by an addon count as Other-
ClearLuaErrorGroup("Other-")
	</code>
</example>
